name: rpi-usage
description: Usage lookup: /usage queries the current model provider's balance or plan quota through the host scripted usage-provider framework — built-in DeepSeek, GLM Coding Plan, MiniMax Token Plan and Kimi Code scripts — and keeps a footer status line; custom providers drop in as user scripts.
author: revpidev
descriptionZh: 用量查询:/usage 经宿主脚本化 usage-provider 框架查询当前接入 provider 的余额/套餐配额(内置 DeepSeek/GLM Coding Plan/MiniMax Token Plan/Kimi Code 四家脚本),footer 自动展示;用户脚本可扩展自定义 provider。
